coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: The EPA said on 8 March 2023 that storing, cleaning and recycling scrap metal needs a permit under the Waste Management Act. Operators already trading had 30 days to apply, and unpermitted work is punishable (https://edition.mv/news/27340). The ADB working paper on metals and plastic recycling covers scrap exporters but gives no count of permit holders (https://www.adb.org/publications/metals-plastic-recycling-maldives). I found no scrap-dealer register, no recurring report duty and no export licence rule. Trade flows are small (UN Comtrade-based aluminium, copper and ferrous scrap exports). Candidate C1 logged, weak.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: I found no dismantler or used-parts regime. Since 13 July 2025 the transport ministry requires permission to import any land vehicle except two-wheelers, requested through its portal (6th amendment to the motorised land vehicle registration regulation). Importers of four-wheelers also need a verified garage, showroom or warehouse permit, plus age caps (https://standard.mv/male-congestion-spurs-tougher-import-laws-ministry-enforces-garage-permits-and-vehicle-age-caps). The ministry scraps abandoned vehicles itself (281 in the Malé Traffic Decongestion Program by March 2024). Candidate C2 (vehicle importers) logged, weak.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: The livestock sector is tiny. The Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Welfare published biosecurity import guidelines in January 2026. Live animal imports need a permit, a vet certificate and a notification at least 24 hours before arrival, sent by email to the Plant and Animal Quarantine Unit or through the Agriculture Online System (https://en.mmtv.mv/7957). Imports of poultry and livestock are limited to registered farms (https://www.psmnews.mv/en/121030). The farm registry was compiled by email form with a 10 April 2025 deadline (https://edition.mv/news/40092). The buyer base is too small and sits mostly with commercial farms and pet importers. Nothing is worth a candidate beyond C5.

result.competitor: I found no Maldivian product that checks stock against the essential-medicines list. Partial overlaps exist. Generic pharmacy POS and inventory software is sold locally: BUSY (Indian) has a reseller in Male, MocDoc says it is integrated with Aasandha, and Odoo has a pharmacy module. Any of these could track 3-month averages and reorder levels. State Pharma, which took over the former STO pharmacy network, is building its own ERM and e-logistics system and a public portal showing medicine stock across its network, which covers a large share of pharmacies. Feb 2025 government reforms also planned an MFDA digital system for tracking medicine availability; I could not confirm whether it has launched. The oneGov portal handles registration filings only.
result.duty: The duty is real and recent. On 22 July 2026 the MFDA revised its Guideline on Minimum Requirement of Essential Medicine in Pharmacy. Under it, every pharmacy must hold at least 80% of the essential medicines for its grade: 185 for community pharmacies and 381 for facility-based ones. Pharmacies must also calculate and track three-month sales averages and keep at least one month of buffer stock. Existing pharmacies have six months to comply, which works out to about late January 2027. The penalty is a 14-day licence suspension, and new pharmacies are registered only once their stock is complete (adhadhu.com/84626, atolltimes.mv/post/news/16610, both dated 23 July 2026). Separately, the MFDA Medicines Regulation takes effect on 22 October. The article, dated 28 July 2026, implies the year is 2026, but the year is not stated. It requires registration with a 3-year licence, notification for storing vaccines and biologics, a Pharmacist Card, prescription and labelling standards, and limits on online sales, with fines of MVR 10,000 to 100,000 (maldivesvoice.mv/3078). I did not see the regulation text, so its record-keeping duties are unverified. I found no recurring reporting duty to the MFDA.
result.market: About 445 licensed pharmacies nationwide (270 in the atolls, 175 in Male), per an MMTV report from March 2026. In 2025 roughly 20 to 69 were newly registered and 20 to 33 lost their licences; outlets give conflicting figures. A meaningful share are run by the State Pharma network or by hospitals, which leaves perhaps 250 to 350 independent buyers.
result.reason: The duties are real, mandatory and current: an 80% stock requirement against a list, with sales-average and buffer tracking, enforced by a 14-day suspension, plus a new regulation from 22 October 2026. But the market is tiny, at about 445 pharmacies, and many belong to State Pharma or hospitals that are building their own stock systems. The recurring part, checking stock against the list and reordering, is really a feature of ordinary pharmacy POS and inventory software, which is already sold locally. The licence cycle is every 3 years and change notices are rare. Willingness to pay is limited, and the one-off compliance push ends around January 2027. It could work as a feature or add-on for a POS vendor, but it is weak as a standalone product for a solo founder.

result.reason: The duty is real. Food Safety Act 6/2024 requires food establishments to be registered and licensed with MFDA. Registration is valid for one year and is renewed via the free oneGov portal. Fines run MVR 10,000-500,000, and unlicensed outlets can be closed (45 closures in Greater Malé, Sept 2025). Residential-area outlets and temporary vendors are exempt. The state portal already does the core job (application and renewal). I found no mandated HACCP, temperature-log, medical or training records, so a compliance-records product has no clear basis. Buyers are low-margin tea shops with little willingness to pay. Market size was not found in a register. No private competitor was seen, but a Dhivehi-language competitor search found nothing new. Only an inspection-readiness checklist or reminder tool is possible, and it would be thin.
